versions.content: function Read [SWS_DM_01522] Upstream: RS_Diag_04135 virtual auto Read ( std::size_t recommended_number_bytes_to_return, MetaInfo const &meta_info, CancellationHandler cancellation_handler) noexcept -> ara::core::Future < ara::core::Vector < ara::core::Byte > >=0; Reads data chunk from the application.
